ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the anomaly correlation record was ingested into the raw-data store

interface_name.description: Name of the collector interface that produced the record

reportName.description: Identifier of the source report the record was extracted from

reportFolder.description: Source folder of the ingested report

key.description: Unique key identifying the anomaly correlation record

cams_issue.description: Key of the CAMS ticket this anomaly correlation is linked to

origin.description: Origin of the anomaly, propagated to the linked CAMS ticket

description.description: Free-text description of the anomaly, propagated to the linked CAMS ticket

datatake_ids.description: Identifiers of the datatakes impacted by the anomaly

acquisition_pass.description: Acquisition pass keys impacted by the anomaly (satellite, station type, identifier and ground station)

products.description: Names of the products impacted by the anomaly
